entry.title: Welcome to my blog
entry.content:
Hi, and welcome to my blog. This first post is also a gallery of the things I can use when writing here. The examples below are illustrative.

Text and links

A paragraph can include bold, italic, strikethrough, and inline code. Here is a link to Jekyll and a footnote for an additional thought.1

A blockquote is useful for highlighting a passage or a thought.

An unordered list:

  • Read and collect ideas.
  • Make a small example.
    • Add notes and references.
  • Share what worked.

A numbered list:

  1. Ask a question.
  2. Explore the data.
  3. Explain the result.

Images

A single image can have descriptive alternative text and a caption:

Two images can also sit side by side:

Mathematics

Inline math works like this: the Pythagorean theorem is \(a^2 + b^2 = c^2\), and Euler’s identity is \(e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0\).

Display equations work too. Here is the Gaussian integral:

\[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} \, dx = \sqrt{\pi}\]

And the definition of the derivative:

\[f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x + h) - f(x)}{h}\]

Code

Fenced code blocks support syntax highlighting:

def moving_average(values):
    """Return the mean of a nonempty list."""
    return sum(values) / len(values)

print(moving_average([2, 4, 6]))  # 4.0

Tables

Method Example use Result
Mean Summarize values 4.0
Median Find the middle value 4.0
Maximum Find the largest value 6.0

Diagram

Mermaid diagrams turn text into a flowchart:

flowchart LR
    A[Question] --> B[Collect data]
    B --> C[Analyze]
    C --> D[Share results]

Chart

This interactive chart uses example data:

{
  "type": "line",
  "data": {
    "labels": ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"],
    "datasets": [{
      "label": "Example observations",
      "data": [2, 4, 3, 6, 5],
      "borderColor": "#b57614",
      "backgroundColor": "rgba(181, 118, 20, 0.2)",
      "tension": 0.25
    }]
  },
  "options": { "responsive": true }
}

Tabs

  • Python
  • JavaScript 
  • print("Hello, world!")

  • console.log("Hello, world!");

Expandable details

Click to reveal a note

Details sections can hold supplementary explanations without interrupting the main text.

More options

The theme can also include video, audio, notebooks, citations, and other specialized content when the corresponding files or services are set up. See the al-folio example posts for additional formats.

  1. Footnotes keep supporting information close at hand without interrupting the main text. ↩
